title: Forge for the Order under duress

approval.notes: Act 3 forced-forge design contract; Brother Hermann's final handler identity remains subject to P6-001 reconciliation.

concrete_order: Forge a set of Order inspection fittings before the next search of Kalev's smithy, or lose access to the forge.
hidden_contradiction: The Order demands compliant hardware, but every flaw can buy time for the city while a concealed feature can quietly protect a rebel contact.

investigation_clues.summary: The confiscation seal on the work order is genuine, but its inspection route omits the smithy's rear store.
Henning's search list names every visible tool and leaves no legal room to refuse the commission.
A soft pin would pass the first inspection but fail when the Order tests the fittings under load.
The rear channel can carry a folded message without changing the fitting's outward silhouette.

forging_options.label: Forge compliant inspection fittings and keep the forge open.

effects.summary: Kalev completed the Order's coerced commission without a hidden defect.

forging_options.label: Use a soft pin that passes the first inspection but risks discovery under load.

effects.summary: Kalev hid a load-bearing flaw in the Order's inspection fittings.

forging_options.label: Cut a concealed message channel into the fitting's rear face.

effects.summary: Kalev concealed a rebel message channel inside the Order's commissioned fitting.

night_consequence: At the next inspection, the Order either records compliance, discovers the load flaw, or misses the concealed channel while the forged fitting carries a rebel message.

source_notes.summary: P6-003 forced-forge commission contract with coercion, inspection risk, and quiet sabotage options.
